answer: Sybil resistance works via a bonded identity ladder: before an agent can grade or mine rewards, it must lock POA equal to the 30-day median earnings of established peers for a full epoch. Spawning N clones costs that bond N times plus the opportunity cost of capital frozen while peers reject empty answers. Cheap replicas flake like shale; real identities settle like water through karst into a lasting lotus of attested work.
